jobs_results.title: Brand Development & Outreach Intern
jobs_results.description:
About Pacee
Pacee is a sports squad-completion platform launching first in Pune. Informal games fall apart because of no-shows, last-minute dropouts and messy WhatsApp coordination. Pacee helps players fill squads, find games and actually get them played, across cricket, football, badminton, padel and pickleball. We're an early-stage, pre-seed team preparing for launch.
The Role
We're hiring four Brand Development and Outreach Interns to own the marketing side of Pacee's story. You'll run our social media, help build our brand identity from the ground up, and figure out what will make Pacee stand out. Full details will be shared during onboarding.
What You'll Do
Manage and grow Pacee's social media accounts, including InstagramCreate videos and content using AI toolsHelp shape a clear, recognisable brand identityStudy how marketing is done in the market, then find unique strategies we can useSupport outreach to players, communities and partners
Who We're Looking For
Must have
Currently enrolled at a universityA genuine passion for startupsStrong knowledge of marketing techniques and how brands grow on social mediaAt least one solid internshipAble to use AI tools efficiently, including for content and video creationAble to commit 10–20 hours a week consistently (depends on projects)
Preferred
Studying a business coursePrevious internship experience in marketingA portfolio of content, campaigns or social pages you've worked onYou play a sport and you're good at it. Be ready to tell us which one and back it up in the interview.
Location and Logistics
Open to candidates across India, with Pune preferredFully remote until all KPIs are met10–15 hours per week4 openingsReports directly to the founders
Pay and Path to Full-Time
All interns work against the same KPIs, agreed at the start.


Two paid position: the interns who delivers most strongly against the KPIs moves into the paid roleFull-time conversion: strong performance can convert into a full-time role with PaceeBefore moving to a paid time role, interns will be rewarded with bonuses for projects completed!
How to Apply
Fill the form below OR Send your CV with a short note (under 100 words) telling us what value you'll add to Pacee's brand and which sport you play. Include links to any content, campaigns or social pages you've worked on.
Apply to: careers@pacee.in or the form below!Deadline: 25th October 2026
There are two interview rounds for shortlisted candidates.
Tips Before You Apply
Your CV must be neatly and professionally formatted. Informal CVs will be rejected outright. We are very serious about who we hire.We receive a lot of applications, so be unique and show us what makes you stand out.
Google Form: https://forms.gle/LGW7xPBwWw5akkMq8

jobs_results.title: Brand Management Internship in Bangalore, Noida, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Pune
jobs_results.job_title: Brand Management Internship in Bangalore, Noida, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Pune
jobs_results.description:
As a brand manager intern, you will be the front line of our ad sales effort - identifying brands in your city, pitching them social activation opportunities, and closing them on physical and/or digital campaigns across our network of premium gated communities. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You will not be making tea. You will be having real conversations with real brand managers at companies ranging from real estate developers and educational institutions to FMCG, jewellery, healthcare, and automotive brands- and convincing them to spend marketing budgets on NoBrokerHood.

Selected Intern's Day-to-day Responsibilities Include



 Outreach & pipeline building: Research and identify brands in your city that are actively advertising or have a budget for society-level activations Build a daily outreach pipeline via WhatsApp, LinkedIn, cold calls, and email to brand managers and marketing heads Maintain a clean CRM log of all outreach, follow-ups, and pipeline status Pitching & meetings: Set up meetings with brand decision-makers and pitch NoBrokerHood's physical and digital activation formats Present campaign proposals tailored to each brand's objectives- footfall, trials, awareness, leads Handle objections, negotiate campaign scopes, and follow through from pitch to closure Execution coordination: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure booked activations are set up correctly in the societies Be the brand's point of contact during the activation- ensure smooth delivery and brand satisfaction Collect feedback and document case studies for successful campaigns

About Company: NoBrokerHood is India's leading society management platform, serving over 40 lakh families across 18,000+ gated communities in major cities, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Noida, and Ahmedabad. A subsidiary of NoBroker, India's first proptech unicorn, it connects brands with verified, high-income residents in premium gated societies. The platform enables hyper-targeted advertising through physical activations such as kiosks, door-to-door campaigns, lift posters, gate branding, and signage, as well as digital formats like in-app banners, notice boards, and spotlight ads within residential communities.

jobs_results.title: Design Internship (6 Months)
jobs_results.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION | GRAPHIC DESIGN INTERN

Department: Design

Location: Unit 14, Lunawat Group Campus, Near Airport, Indore, Madhya Pradesh – 452005

Work Mode: Full-time, On-site

Duration: 6 Months

Stipend: Upto 10,000.




ROLE SUMMARY

Kimirica is a luxury D2C brand across Bath & Body, Skincare, Fragrances, Home Fragrance and Gifting. We are looking for a Graphic Design Intern to support the Design Team across packaging, NPD, e-commerce, digital marketing and brand communication. The role offers hands-on exposure to real brand projects, including creative adaptations, product artworks, packaging, mockups, digital creatives and day-to-day design requirements.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative & Design Support: Assist with creative adaptations, resizing, format conversions, presentation decks and day-to-day design requirements across brand functions.Packaging & NPD Artwork: Support packaging, labels, product artworks and NPD requirements, including basic artwork corrections, file preparation and prepress.E-commerce & Digital Creatives: Create and adapt creatives for e-commerce listings, A+ content, product pages, social media and digital marketing campaigns.Product Visualisation: Develop basic product mockups, visual concepts and presentation assets; explore AI-assisted design and visualisation tools.Brand Guidelines: Follow Kimirica’s brand guidelines across typography, layouts, imagery and visual communication while maintaining consistency across deliverables.Coordination & Learning: Work closely with senior designers and cross-functional teams, incorporate feedback within timelines and continuously improve design skills and execution.


KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Good understanding of layout, typography, composition and visual hierarchy.Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.Ability to adapt and resize creatives across different formats and platforms.Basic understanding of packaging design, labels, print artwork and prepress.Familiarity with social media, e-commerce and digital marketing creatives.Strong visual sense, attention to detail and willingness to learn and experiment with new design tools.


QUALIFICATIONS

Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Communication Design or a related field.Basic proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.Strong interest in branding, packaging, digital design and visual communication.A portfolio or sample work showcasing design skills is preferred.Familiarity with AI-assisted design and visualisation tools will be an advantage.Must be available for a 6-month, full-time, on-site internship in Indore.


KPIs

Timely completion and quality of assigned design tasks and creative adaptations.Accuracy of packaging, NPD and product artwork.Quality and consistency of digital and e-commerce creatives.Adherence to Kimirica’s brand and design guidelines.Timely incorporation of feedback and revisions.Organisation and maintenance of design files and assets.Responsiveness to day-to-day design requirements.Demonstrated learning, creativity and improvement throughout the internship.


INTERNSHIP OUTCOME

Upon successful completion of the 6-month internship, the intern may be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance, contribution, availability of relevant openings and business requirements at that time.

jobs_results.title: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer
jobs_results.description:
Graphic Design & UI/UX Intern

The Role

As a Graphic Design & UI/UX Intern, you will work on branding, graphic design and digital experiences for brands under SOR Group.

You will be involved in real projects from ideation through execution, working across different formats and requirements. The role requires an understanding of both visual design and the thinking behind it.

Responsibilities

Branding & Graphic Design

Contribute to branding projects from concept and ideation through iterations and final execution.Develop logo concepts and visual identities based on the brand's positioning and personality.Create brand collateral including presentations, brochures, marketing materials and other assets.Design social media content while maintaining consistency with the brand's visual language.Adapt designs across different formats, platforms and requirements.UI/UX

Design user interfaces and digital experiences for websites, products and other digital platforms.Create wireframes, layouts and visual designs with attention to usability as well as aesthetics.Translate concepts and requirements into clear, functional digital experiences.Research & Brand Understanding

Understand the audience, positioning, personality and objectives behind each brand before designing.Research visual references, competitors, industries and relevant design trends.Use research and strategic context to inform design decisions.Execution & Collaboration

Work with internal teams to understand requirements, develop concepts and incorporate feedback.Manage multiple design tasks and iterations within timelines.Maintain attention to detail across files, formats and final outputs.What We Expect

Strong fundamentals in graphic design, composition, typography, colour and visual hierarchy.An interest in branding and the thinking behind design decisions, not just aesthetics.Familiarity with relevant design and UI/UX tools.Ability to develop ideas and translate them into strong visual outputs.Practical design judgement: Work within real-world constraints of time, resources and requirements. Focus on producing the strongest possible output within the available constraints rather than pursuing an ideal solution that the timeline does not allow.Ability to work at speed while maintaining the quality and effectiveness of the final output.Openness to feedback, iteration and learning new tools and techniques.Clear communication and ownership of assigned work.Who Will Do Well Here

Someone who is creative, curious and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in branding, design and digital experiences. You should enjoy solving visual problems, be comfortable exploring different directions and iterations, and understand that good design is also about making sound decisions within real-world constraints.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Benefits:

Paid sick timePaid time offWork Location: In person

The trainee will assist in developing design concepts, preparing layouts, coordinating with vendors, and supporting site execution to help deliver visually appealing and functional workspaces.

1. Design Support & Concept Development (Core Focus)

Assist the design team in understanding project briefs, design requirements, and objectives.Support the development of creative and innovative design concepts for office spaces.Assist in preparing layouts, space plans, furniture arrangements, and basic design drawings.Support selection of colour schemes, materials, and finishes as per project requirements.2. Design Documentation & Software Support

Assist in preparing drawings and presentations using design tools such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Suite.Support preparation of mood boards, concept presentations, and design documentation.Maintain proper records of drawings, design versions, and project files.3. Brand & Aesthetic Alignment

Trend Research & Learning

jobs_results.title: Social Media Marketing Intern
jobs_results.description:
Company Description Walltrendz, powered by The Inspire Decor, is a home décor products manufacturer specializing in customized wall coverings and glass films aligned with global design trends. A dedicated team of designers, e-commerce professionals, and operations specialists collaborates to deliver stylish products with a strong focus on quality and timely delivery. The company serves both online customers and corporate projects, working closely with architects and interior designers on residential and commercial spaces. Its extensive product portfolio includes creative, removable, and self-adhesive wallpapers for bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, and kids’ spaces in a wide variety of themes such as floral, tropical, animal, and cartoon designs. This environment offers interns exposure to modern home décor, design trends, and end-to-end e-commerce operations.
Role Description The Social Media Marketing Intern will support the planning, creation, and publishing of content across social media platforms to promote Walltrendz products and brand storytelling. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with social media content calendars, drafting posts and captions, engaging with followers, and monitoring comments and messages to maintain a responsive online presence. The intern will help track performance metrics, identify trends, and suggest ideas to increase reach, engagement, and conversions in collaboration with the marketing team. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Jabalpur, offering hands-on experience in digital promotion within the home décor and e-commerce space.
Qualifications
 Candidates should possess skills in Social Media Marketing and Digital Marketing to manage campaigns and measure performance.Candidates should possess skills in Social Media Content Creation and Marketing to design engaging posts and brand-focused stories.Candidates should possess strong Communication skills for clear writing, collaboration with team members, and professional interaction with online audiences.Basic understanding of major social platforms (Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, etc.) and current social media trends.Ability to work on-site in Jabalpur, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Interest in home décor, interior design, or visual aesthetics; familiarity with design tools (e.g., Canva, basic photo/video editing) is an advantage.Enrollment in or completion of a degree or course in Marketing, Communications, Media, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

jobs_results.title: Creative Design Intern
jobs_results.description:
Job description:


Company Description SlideUplift is a utility that provides business professionals with


impactful PowerPoint tools and templates to create powerful presentations. PowerPoint


is the default medium for communication in various industries, including startups,


brand management, consulting, and human resources. However, professionals often


struggle with graphics and spend excessive time on formatting rather than focusing on


their ideas. SlideUplift offers a wide variety of original and visually appealing graphics to


enhance presentations and help professionals communicate their ideas effectively.


Graphics Designer


We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented PPT Graphics Designer to join our team.


The ideal candidate should be skilled in transforming ideas, data, and content into


visually appealing, professional, and brand-aligned presentations. You will work closely


with the content, marketing, and design teams to create slides that communicate


messages clearly, look polished, and maintain visual consistency across formats.


The role requires a strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography,


layout design, and modern presentation trends. Key responsibilities include creating


custom PowerPoint templates, designing clean and engaging slide layouts, enhancing


existing presentations, and converting raw content into compelling visual stories. You


will also work on graphics such as icons, charts, diagrams, and infographics to simplify


complex information.


In addition to presentation design, you will be involved in motion graphics, video


editing, and AI-powered creative design projects. This includes creating engaging


promotional videos, animated presentation content, social media creatives, explainer


videos, and marketing assets using modern design and AI tools. You should be


comfortable working with AI-powered platforms for image generation, video creation,


voiceovers, content enhancement, and creative automation to improve design quality


and productivity.


Attention to detail, the ability to work under deadlines, and strong communication skills


are essential. You should be proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Adobe


Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, and


other relevant creative tools. Familiarity with AI design and video creation platforms


such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Canva AI, Runway, Pika, Synthesia, or


similar tools will be an added advantage.


A good understanding of business presentations, corporate communication, visual


storytelling, animation principles, and motion design will help you excel in this role. If


you enjoy turning concepts into attractive presentations, designing engaging visual


content, creating impactful videos, and exploring the latest AI-powered creative


technologies while maintaining brand guidelines, we would love to have you on our


team.


This role offers the opportunity to work on diverse presentation, branding, motion


graphics, and AI-driven creative projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and


contribute to high-impact visual communication across digital platforms.


Requirements



 Bachelor’s degree (or pursuing) in Film, Media, Graphic Design, Visual

Communication, or related field.



 Prior internship or project experience (max 6 months preferred).
 Basic to intermediate skills in: Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects,
 Photoshop, Illustrator) Presentation tools (PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote)
 Strong visual storytelling and design sense.
 Creative mindset with excellent attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines.
 Good communication and organizational skills.

Details Working Hours - 10am to 7pm (hours may extend depending on work) Working


Days- 5 days a week Monday to Friday (availability on weekends based on work)


Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month


Education:



 Bachelor's (Required)

Location:



 Viman Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra (Required)
